James Hogg, The Private Memoirs and Confessions of a Justified Sinner.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/james-hogg/the-private-memoirs-and-confessions-of-a-justified-sinner

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- James Hogg, the author, died 1835 (Wikidata Q941810, P570 = 1835-11-21).

First publication of the text used: 1824 (SE colophon: 'The Private Memoirs and Confessions of a Justified Sinner was published in 1824 by James Hogg.'). The Wikipedia article says the only edition in Hogg's lifetime was published by Longman, Hurst, Rees, Orme, Brown, and Green in London on 12 July 1824, and in Edinburgh three days later. The infobox gives the country as Scotland, part of the United Kingdom.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1824, before 1931, so the US rule settles its origin too. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1919.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom, London and Edinburgh, 1824): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die did so in 1835, so the work entered the public domain there on 1 January 1906.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
